cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The office kettle's on strike. Help me negotiate before the clients arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've filled it twice. It still won't boil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then water isn't its grievance. Tell it we'll stop leaving it alone after meetings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can take it into the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Give it my chair. A seat at the table should get us tea.

mechanism: A teaches a colleague to negotiate with a striking kettle, replacing mechanical troubleshooting with workplace representation.
confusable: Getting B to perform an odd ritual is D145; D151 needs an impossible causal explanation used as the practical remedy.
comparison: Office hospitality and representation differ from redirecting a house's alleged migration.
seedUse: Keep failed refilling and meeting inclusion; make A correct B's diagnosis and inclusion terms.
